message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build Awery

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs: 
      channel:
        description: "Channel"
        default: "alpha"
        type: choice
        options:
          - alpha
          - beta
          - stable
  workflow_call: 
    inputs:
      channel:
        description: "Channel"
        default: "alpha"
        type: string

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          
      - name: Setup JDK 17
        if: ${{ env.SKIP_BUILD != 'true' }}
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 17
          cache: gradle

      - name: Grant execute permission for gradlew
        run: chmod +x gradlew
      
      - name: Build Mobile Apk
        id: build_mobile_apk
        run: ./gradlew assemble${{ inputs.channel }}MobileRelease -Pbuildkonfig.flavor=${{ inputs.channel }}

      - name: Build TV Apk
        id: build_tv_apk
        run: ./gradlew assemble${{ inputs.channel }}TvRelease -Pbuildkonfig.flavor=${{ inputs.channel }}

#      - name: Build Exe
#        id: build_exe
#        run: ./gradlew packageExe -Pbuildkonfig.flavor=${{ inputs.channel }}

      - name: Sign Mobile Apk
        if: success()
        uses: r0adkll/sign-android-release@v1
        with:
          releaseDirectory: app/build/outputs/apk/${{ inputs.channel }}Mobile/release
          signingKeyBase64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_SIGNING_KEY }}
          alias: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          keyStorePassword: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          keyPassword: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        env:
          BUILD_TOOLS_VERSION: "34.0.0"

      - name: Sign Tv Apk
        if: success()
        uses: r0adkll/sign-android-release@v1
        with:
          releaseDirectory: app/build/outputs/apk/${{ inputs.channel }}Tv/release
          signingKeyBase64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_SIGNING_KEY }}
          alias: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          keyStorePassword: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          keyPassword: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        env:
          BUILD_TOOLS_VERSION: "34.0.0"
          
      - name: Rename Mobile Apk File
        run: |
          mv app/build/outputs/apk/${{ inputs.channel }}Mobile/release/app-${{ inputs.channel }}-mobile-release-signed.apk app/build/outputs/apk/${{ inputs.channel }}Mobile/release/awery-mobile-${{ inputs.channel }}.apk

      - name: Rename Tv Apk File
        run: |
          mv app/build/outputs/apk/${{ inputs.channel }}Tv/release/app-${{ inputs.channel }}-tv-release-signed.apk app/build/outputs/apk/${{ inputs.channel }}Tv/release/awery-tv-${{ inputs.channel }}.apk

      - name: Upload Mobile Apk
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: "Mobile Apk"
          retention-days: 90
          path: "app/build/outputs/apk/${{ inputs.channel }}Mobile/release/awery-mobile-${{ inputs.channel }}.apk"

      - name: Upload Tv Apk
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: "Tv Apk"
          retention-days: 90
          path: "app/build/outputs/apk/${{ inputs.channel }}Tv/release/awery-tv-${{ inputs.channel }}.apk"",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a reusable/manual Android build that can be re-triggered on the same ref, so superseded in-progress builds waste VM time. The P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE pattern (cancel superseded runs) applies: runs represent the same workflow and branch/ref, and a newer build supersedes older ones. Adding a concurrency group scoped by workflow and ref with cancel-in-progress cancels stale builds when a new one starts, saving resources without changing build steps, coverage, permissions, or adding secrets/deployment. Gradle dependency caching is already present via setup-java cache: gradle, and there is no matrix for fail-fast or representative duration history for a custom timeout, so cancel-stale is the best-supported minimal change.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
